templateRationale: Reuse only the generic full-f16 transformer mechanism policy. Every model semantic field is reconstructed from accepted ModelIR facts, and the unproven chat path remains disabled.

rejected.reason: Rejected because it discards the heterogeneous local/full block schedule and per-block positional contract.
Rejected because declaring vocabulary compatibility without materializing and validating the runtime manifest would leave a semantic truth gap.
Rejected because vision.encode has complete source representation but no generic lowering or qualification.
Rejected by physical Node WebGPU validation because the inherited head256 prefill specialization cannot execute the source-proven 128-wide attention geometry.
Rejected by exact physical parity because the generic bundled tokenizer failed to recognize the source TemplateProcessing begin_of_text boundary as BOS.
Rejected at the first semantic boundary because a source-declared weightless Q/K RMSNorm was executed with the centered learned-weight offset and doubled both normalized projections.
Rejected because widening persistent KV state to f32 preserved the same seven-token prefix and the same token-7 divergence as the f16-KV candidate.
